overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board could discuss the police lieutenant's discipline in open session, since executive session is never required.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed discipline of a police lieutenant in open session on June 14 when it should have gone into executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Even if the discussion had constituted a discussion regarding discipline of a particular employee, the Board was not required to hold such a discussion in executive session.
